tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_2.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
# z-score within group
df['z'] = df.apply(lambda r: (r['BilledCost'] - g.mean().loc[(r['SubAccountName'], r['ServiceName'])]) / g.std().loc[(r['SubAccountName'], r['ServiceName'])], axis=1)
top = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])
